text:
maria: Quick sync — following Friday's postmortem on the GPU surge. I want a compact owner/timeline list for the follow-ups so we can hand off into the next sprint. Who's taking what?
aj: I can take scheduler knobs + rollout plan. ETA end of week?
suhas: I'll own quota backstop work and the emergency headroom policy. Drafted initial plan below.
```
- SUHAS: quota backstop request -> submit ticket to infra-alloc by Tue 03/31
- SUHAS: headroom policy -> propose target (12%) + metrics to monitor by Wed 04/01
- AJ: scheduler tuning -> PR for burst window and preemption threshold by Thu 04/02
- MARIA: rollout playbook -> canary + fallback config + runbook updates by Fri 04/03
- LEO: capacity forecasts -> 90/95th percentile surge model + commit by Mon 04/06
- EMMA: customer impact log -> short summary for CS/AE by Wed 04/01
```
leo: I ran a quick sim — with a 12% headroom target we avoid ~85% of the observed tail events. Will attach sim results in GH.
emma: I'll collect impacted customers and add notes for support. Also will flag any enterprise accounts for a proactive reachout.
ops-bot: Notice: quota-request #452 opened by suhas. Link: <https://issues.redwood/internal/452|quota-request-452>
aj: Quick question — do we want the scheduler changes in two steps (safe then aggressive) or one go?
maria: Two steps. Safe first, monitor token latency for 24h, then ramp. Add metric hooks for per-model tail latency.
suhas: Agreed. Also adding a rolling window alarm: if tail latency > 1500ms for 3m, auto-fallback to smaller model variant.
leo: I'll add a conservative capacity cushion in forecasts to feed Dedicated capacity commit planning.
aj: I'll post a short config diff in #eng-releases, include recommended canary percentages and a rollback command.
emma: CS note: drafting outbound 1:1 templates. Will sync with legal for wording on SLA blips.
maria: Ownership sanity check: suhas (quota + headroom), aj (scheduler rollout), leo (forecasts), emma (customer comms), me (playbook + runbook). Is everyone good?
suhas: Good. Will update the ticket with the proposed thresholds and monitoring playbook.
leo: Good for me. Sim results will be in GH by EOD.
aj: Good. I'll make the PR and tag the oncall for the canary.
emma: Good. I'll loop in CS leads.
maria: Excellent. Please update the central follow-up doc and set the JIRA epics. I'll do a check-in on Fri standup. :thumbsup:
aj: FYI — one implementation note: changing preemption threshold to 0.25 needs kernel restart on some hosts; I'll list the hosts to avoid surprises.
suhas: Noted — include host list and maintenance windows in the playbook.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance-window calendar updated for 04/02 02:00-05:00 UTC.
leo: Quick ask — can we set a short-lived autoscale override for high-traffic test on 04/04? I want to validate forecasts against real load.
maria: Yes, schedule it and annotate the experiment in the playbook. Use feature-flagged override only for that window.
aj: Putting in a draft canary schedule now. Will post link when ready.
leo: Link to sim: <https://gh.redwood/sim-results/gpu-headroom-03-31|sim-results>
suhas: Ticket updated: https://issues.redwood/internal/452 -> contains thresholds, rollbacks, and monitoring hooks.
emma: Draft CS note uploaded to confluence: <https://confluence.redwood/gpu-postmortem-comms|postmortem-comms>
maria: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for final signoffs. If anything slips, call it out here so I can escalate to ops lead.
aj: acked.
suhas: ack.
leo: ack.
emma: ack.
